description: Tells how Marie Tharp reconstructed the ocean floor from depth profiles, recognized the central valley of the mid-ocean ridge and connected mapping to earthquake evidence. Explains the difference between measured soundings and inferred terrain, the collaboration with Bruce Heezen, and the contribution of seafloor maps to plate tectonics.
